title: Spanish farmers hold tractor protest in Madrid against EU policy

tea.why: Farmers reject the partial agreement on the Common Agricultural Policy.
tea.want: A government emergency plan to guarantee the profitability and future of the agricultural sector.
tea.changed: Oct 28: Protests were suspended following a train crash in Toledo province.

summary: Agricultural associations Asaja, Coag, and Unión de Uniones called for a tractor demonstration in Madrid to demand an emergency plan from the government guaranteeing the profitability and future of the farming sector, while also rejecting the partial agreement on the Common Agricultural Policy. According to reports, the protest was subsequently suspended following a fatal train accident in Toledo province that caused high-speed rail cancellations between Andalucía and Madrid, leaving some participants stranded and requiring alternative transport back.
demands: An emergency plan to guarantee sector profitability and future
response: According to Asaja Málaga, the protest was suspended following the train accident in Toledo province, and organizers worked to account for and assist stranded participants.

updates.text: Asaja, Coag and Unión de Uniones called a tractor protest in Madrid over agricultural policy and sector profitability.
Asaja Málaga confirmed the protest was suspended following a fatal train crash in Toledo province.
